contract: GET /items/:id/file/:fileid/download candidate recorded from server/routers/ApiRouter.js:126. Method, path, query/body variants, auth/permission gates, payload shape/types, errors and side effects must match upstream v2.37.2.

invariants.contract: LibraryItemController middleware resolves the item, library access, and requested library file ID before downloadLibraryFile checks canDownload; therefore a missing file ID returns sendStatus(404) even for a user without download permission, while an existing file returns sendStatus(403).

When the requested library file record exists but its disk path is missing, upstream download handling returns status 404 with body 'File not found'; an audio MIME type selected before res.download is preserved and receives the string-response charset, Content-Length, and weak ETag.

exceptions: This sample verifies selected file-download normal/error/edge behavior; Apple-mobile MIME override, X-Accel-Redirect, other library-file types, and non-ENOENT filesystem errors remain unverified.
